candidates.question:
The function $f$ is defined by
$f(x) = \frac{x^2 - x - 6}{x - 3}$ for $x \neq 3$, and $f(3) = k$.
Find the value of $k$ for which $f$ is continuous at $x = 3$.

lines.text: $f$ is continuous at $x = 3$ when $\lim_{x\to3} f(x) = f(3) = k$.

skill.title: Apply Corollary 1: A diagonal divides a parallelogram into two congruent triangles
skill.output: unknown found, justified by citing Corollary 1

candidates.question:
$ABCD$ is a parallelogram.
$|\angle CAB| = 35^\circ$ and $|\angle ACB| = 70^\circ$.
Find $|\angle ADC|$.

lines.text: The angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$.
The diagonal $[AC]$ divides the parallelogram into two congruent triangles, $ABC$ and $CDA$, with $B$ matching $D$.
So the angles at $B$ and $D$ are equal.

candidates.question:
$PQRS$ is a parallelogram with $|PQ| = 8$ cm, $|QR| = 6$ cm and diagonal $|PR| = 10$ cm.
Find the area of $PQRS$.

lines.text: Use Heron's formula.
The diagonal $[PR]$ divides the parallelogram into two congruent triangles, so the parallelogram has twice the area of triangle $PQR$.

candidates.question:
$ABCD$ is a parallelogram.
$|\angle BCA| = (2x + 10)^\circ$ and $|\angle DAC| = (3x - 20)^\circ$.
Find the value of $x$.

lines.text: The diagonal $[AC]$ divides the parallelogram into congruent triangles $ABC$ and $CDA$, with $C$ matching $A$.
So $|\angle BCA| = |\angle DAC|$.
Each angle is $70^\circ$.

candidates.question:

lines.text: A right angle at the circle stands on a diameter, so $[AC]$ is a diameter.

candidates.question:
$A$, $B$ and $C$ are points on a circle with centre $O$. $\angle ABC = 90°$ and $\angle BAC = 28°$.
Find $\angle OBC$.

lines.text: A right angle at the circle stands on a diameter, so $[AC]$ is a diameter and $O$ lies on $[AC]$.
$|OA| = |OB|$ (radii), so $\angle ABO = \angle BAO = 28°$.
